# script role

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:scriptRole`](gmeow-scriptRole.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/scriptRole>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/languages`](../../slices/languages.md)

The functional role a writing system plays for a language in a usage (a [`gmeow:ScriptRole`](../classes/gmeow-ScriptRole.md) value). Functional: one role per usage — a script playing two roles is two usages.
